pr_title: session: improve the log for unsupport collation when connecting
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/34964

Problem Summary:

MySQL 8.0 client will use `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci` as the default collation for `utf8mb4` when create a new connection, but tidb does support this one, and we can not return an error because most users will not change their connect string, return error will block new session in this case. so we decide to use the `utf8mb4_bin` substitute silently and give a warning log. 

This pr makes the log more clear

issue_context.title: confusing log on new connection arrives
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

there will have a warning log when a new connection arrives using mysql8.0 client
```
[WARN] [collate.go:220] ["[ddl:1273]Unsupported collation when new collation is enabled: 'utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci'"]
```

it is a little confusing for users.

review_comments: Doesn't this generate a lot of log spam? Imagine a scenario where a user uses a MySQL 8 connector, we don't support the default collation - I assume this will mean one log-line per connect?
yes, one log-line per connect. I think it is ok because it is the same as in the past.
